events.title: Frenchman 에리크 캉토나 agrees to join 리즈 유나이티드 on the same day that his new club return to the top of the First Division with a 3–0 home win over 노츠 카운티, while 맨체스터 유나이티드 are held to a 1–1 draw by 아스널 at Highbury. 첼시 climb into sixth place with a 2–1 win over 리버풀 at Anfield. 셰필드 유나이티드 climb into 17th place with a 5–2 win over 노팅엄 포리스트 at the City Ground . 블랙번 로버스 remain top of the Second Division with a 2–1 home win over 스윈던 타운. Southend remain second with a 1–0 home win over 왓퍼드, with 입스위치 타운 still level on points with them after beating 밀월 3–2 away from home. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 beat 레스터 시티 1–0 at home to move within three points on the playoffs.

렉섬's FA Cup run ends with a 1–0 defeat at home to 웨스트햄 유나이티드 in their fourth round replay. 맨체스터 유나이티드 sell out-of-favour goalkeeper Jim Leighton , who has played for the first team just once in the last 18 months, to 던디 for £250,000.

스완지 시티 winger Alan Davies , 30, is found dead in his car near his home in South Wales . Davies played for 맨체스터 유나이티드 in the 1983 FA Cup final, and later played for 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 브래드퍼드 시티 . 사우샘프턴 knock 맨체스터 유나이티드 out of the FA Cup on penalties in a fourth round replay. 테디 셰링엄 scores a hat-trick for 노팅엄 포리스트 as they beat 크리스털 팰리스 4–2 in the League Cup quarter-final at the City Ground .

뉴캐슬 유나이티드, second from bottom in the Second Division, sack manager Ossie Ardiles after 11 months in charge and replace him with former striker 케빈 키건 . 에리크 캉토나 signs for 리즈 유나이티드 from Nîmes Olympique in a £900,000 deal after turning down a contract with 셰필드 웬즈데이.

Former 리버풀 and England midfielder Terry McDermott is appointed as 케빈 키건's assistant. 리버풀 legend 밥 페이즐리 resigns from the club's board of directors due to ill health, ending a 53-year association with the club.

케빈 키건 starts his managerial career on a high note as 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat 브리스틀 시티 3–0 at home. 아스널 end a seven-match winless run in the league with a 1–0 win at 노츠 카운티, but 리즈 유나이티드's title bid takes a blow when they suffer a 2–0 defeat at 올덤 애슬레틱, with 맨체스터 유나이티드's 1–1 home draw with 셰필드 웬즈데이 being enough to keep them on top. 셰필드 유나이티드's upturn continues with a 4–2 home win over 맨체스터 시티. 윔블던 beat 애스턴 빌라 2–0 to ensure that they stay clear of the relegation zone and begin their recovery from dismal mid-season form. 블랙번 로버스's 3–2 win over Grimsby at Blundell Park ensures that their remain one point ahead at the top of the Second Division, despite second-placed 입스위치 타운's 5–2 home win over 포츠머스. Swindon climb into fourth place with a 2–1 home win over Brighton. Down in the Third Division, a clash between local rivals sees 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 retain their lead of the table with a 3–0 away win over 버밍엄 시티, who stand fourth in the table during their third season at this level.

With the club slipping back into the relegation zone after an initial run of good form under caretaker manager Wes Saunders, Third Division strugglers 토키 유나이티드 take the bold move of appointing Yugoslav manager Ivan Golac until the end of the season.
Second Division strugglers 플리머스 아가일 sack manager David Kemp .

노팅엄 포리스트 thrash 브리스틀 시티 4–1 at the City Ground in the FA Cup fifth round. 첼시 beat 셰필드 유나이티드 1–0 in a match in which 비니 존스 is booked inside the first ten seconds of play. In the league, 아스널 keep their fading title hopes alive with a 7–1 home win over fellow outsiders 셰필드 웬즈데이 at Highbury.
Alan Shearer scores on his full England debut in a 2-0 friendly win over France at Wembley. Also making his debut are 리버풀's Rob Jones and 에버턴's 마틴 키온 .

The Football Association confirms that it will launch the new FA Premier League for next season, contested between the 19 highest-placed teams in this season's final First Division table and the champions, runners-up and playoff winners in the Second Division.
애스턴 빌라 pay a club record £1.7million for 올덤 애슬레틱 defender Earl Barrett .

맨체스터 유나이티드 open up a four-point lead at the top of the First Division by beating 크리스털 팰리스 2–0 at Old Trafford , with 마크 휴스 scoring twice and 페테르 슈마이켈 making a spectacular save from a Simon Rodger shot. 리버풀 fall to a 3–0 defeat to 노리치 시티 at Carrow Road .
Leeds are held to a 1–1 draw by 에버턴 at Goodison Park, which means they are still three points behind 맨체스터 유나이티드, who have a game in hand.

In a set of high-scoring FA Cup fifth round replays, 사우샘프턴 beat 볼턴 원더러스 3–2 at The Dell , 선덜랜드 beat 웨스트햄 유나이티드 3–2 at Upton Park , 리버풀 beat 입스위치 타운 3–2 at Anfield and 포츠머스 beat 미들즈브러 4–2 at Ayresome Park .

20-year-old Australian goalkeeper Mark Bosnich joins 애스턴 빌라 after seven months back in his homeland following his departure from 맨체스터 유나이티드. He joins Les Sealey , who joined Villa from Old Trafford last summer, at Villa Park . After a loan spell, 노리치 시티 midfielder Tim Sherwood makes his move to 블랙번 로버스 permanent for £500,000. The only league action of the day sees 케임브리지 유나이티드 beat 브리스틀 로버스 6–1 in the Second Division at the Abbey Stadium .

February ends with 맨체스터 유나이티드 holding a two-point advantage over second placed 리즈 유나이티드. 사우샘프턴, 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 루턴 타운 remain in the bottom three. 블랙번 로버스 still lead the race for a place in the new Premier League, while 입스위치 타운 are second . The play-off zone is occupied by 케임브리지 유나이티드, 사우스엔드 유나이티드, 미들즈브러 and 더비 카운티. In the Third Division, referee Roger Wiseman is assaulted by a spectator during the 버밍엄 시티 – 스토크 시티 promotion clash at St Andrew's , which ends in a 1–1 draw and sees Stoke top the Third Division.
